meta.title: Reverse auction: bid for less than the auction quantity
warnings: resolved: “Enter an offered quantity of 6 for an auction quantity of 10 in the vendor portal and submit the bid; vendor_bid only ac” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the prepared live auction event required by the setup.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.

args.need: enter 6 as the offered quantity for the 10-unit auction and submit the bid

steps.note: The catalog has no step for editing the vendor's offered quantity.

args.text: Bid Quantity should be equal to the Auction Quantity

steps.note: Assert the required refusal message after the under-quantity submission.
